notes.title: ✨ Update Ver.1.0.0816.21 - Mini Update ✨
notes.content:
- 🎵 Added new sound effect when achieving Perfect in the Bonus Stage
- 🎯 Fixed hit detection for the boss in Zone Y
- 🔤 Corrected spelling mistakes in warning messages

  Wicth → Witch
  Guarder → Guard
- 🤖 Adjusted Asura’s model

Thank you for playing ASURA THE STRIKER! 🙏
We’ll keep polishing the game, so please look forward to future updates. 🚀

notes.content:

Two new costumes have been added, bringing the total to three.
Enjoy the high-speed clash of mechs and bullet storms in your favorite style![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44014816/45877fef712cbe93c795b0a9c5b91856d0adadff.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Update 2: Impact Flash[/b]

notes.title: Ver.1.0.0514.01 Mini Update
notes.content:
[b]## 🛠 Update: Ver.1.0.0514.01[/b]

- VSync is now disabled by default  
- Default resolution is now set to 1920×1080  
- SE/BGM volume lock in the OPTION menu has been removed  
- PRACTICE mode is now fixed to NORMAL difficulty  
- Zone selection in PRACTICE mode now remembers the last cursor position  
- Minor adjustments to UI and some enemy graphics  
- Perfect clears in bonus stages now reward +1 life  
　*Please note: this change may affect difficulty and scoring balance slightly

💡If the game feels too fast, try disabling VSync in the OPTION menu.

We’ll continue to refine the game based on your feedback. Thank you for playing!
